title_zh: NEWS IN 10 每日新聞英語｜11 月 18 日

stories.headline_en: Collins Dictionary Names 'AI' as 2023 Word of the Year
stories.headline_zh: 柯林斯詞典將「AI」選為 2023 年度代表字

sentences.en: Collins Dictionary has chosen 'AI' as its Word of the Year for 2023.
sentences.zh: 柯林斯詞典將「AI」選為 2023 年的年度代表字。

sentences.en: This choice reflects the rapid rise of artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 這項選擇反映了人工智慧的迅速崛起。

sentences.en: AI is now a major topic in daily conversations and news.
sentences.zh: 人工智慧如今已成為日常對話和新聞中的主要話題。

sentences.en: Experts discuss AI's impact on work, creativity, and society.
sentences.zh: 專家們討論人工智慧對工作、創造力和社會的影響。

sentences.en: The word highlights the ongoing debate about machines and people.
sentences.zh: 這個字凸顯了機器與人類之間持續進行的辯論。

stories.headline_en: Taiwan's Stock Market Falls Amid AI Concerns (Oct 2023)
stories.headline_zh: 臺灣股市因人工智慧疑慮而下跌 (2023 年 10 月)

sentences.en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange (TAIEX) closed lower on October 26, 2023.
sentences.zh: 臺灣證券交易所（TAIEX）於 2023 年 10 月 26 日收低。

sentences.en: This drop was due to worries about AI development.
sentences.zh: 這次下跌是受到對人工智慧發展的擔憂影響。

sentences.en: The TAIEX fell by 1.64 percent, reaching 16,073.97 points.
sentences.zh: 臺灣加權指數下跌 1.64%，收在 16,073.97 點。

sentences.en: Major chipmakers like TSMC also saw their shares drop.
sentences.zh: 臺積電等主要晶片製造商的股價也出現下跌。

stories.headline_en: Nvidia Reports Strong Q3 FY2025 Revenue, Exceeding Expectations
stories.headline_zh: 輝達公布 2025 財年第三季營收強勁，超出預期

sentences.en: American chip company Nvidia announced its third-quarter FY2025 revenue.
sentences.zh: 美國晶片公司輝達公布了其 2025 財年第三季營收。

sentences.en: The company's revenue reached over $35.1 billion.
sentences.zh: 該公司營收達到超過 351 億美元。

sentences.en: This figure greatly exceeded analysts' expectations.
sentences.zh: 這個數字大幅超出了分析師的預期。

sentences.en: Nvidia also raised its revenue forecast for the next quarter.
sentences.zh: 輝達也提高了對下一季營收的預測。

sentences.en: Its stock rose after the positive earnings report.
sentences.zh: 在這份正面的財報公布後，其股價上漲。
